purpose: Test normal-length generation on the same isolated CPU/fp32-VAE service after single-frame outputs failed style. Same seed, prompt, weights, dimensions, shift 8 and 20 steps; expand to 65 frames, use built-in zero-reference latent trim and WebM encoding. No control video supplied.
comparison_limits: Frame count changes latent noise shape; comparison is not identical noise samples. Relative to prior MPS video, device, model compute precision and VAE precision also differ; no one-factor root-cause claim.
delivery_rule: Retain raw output. Keep decoded frames 0 through 63 at original 16 fps; drop only end guard frame 64 to deliver 4000 ms. No retiming or unrecorded cropping.
review: First confirm real frame times, size and full decode; inspect actual frames and temporal playback for natural textures, coherent two adults, dark-blue left and beige right clothing, one blue envelope, table contact/release/withdrawal sequence and stationary camera. Unknown tracking must remain unmeasured. No control benefit claim without paired controlled execution.
environment_changes: None; current isolated CPU service, separate database, custom/API nodes disabled
